title: A/R: a payment made after the as-of date is not taken off
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • Customer X has an invoice of $100.00 created on day D.
  • A $40.00 payment on it was recorded on day D + 5 (a past day).
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Set the date chip to day D + 2.
  4. Open every bucket.
  5. Read the invoice's two money columns (Amount, Open balance).
  6. Set the date chip to day D + 5.
  7. Open every bucket.
  8. Read the invoice's Open balance.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • Amount $100.00, Open balance $100.00 (the payment came later).

Step 8:

  • Open balance $60.00.

Why this matters: A past month-end report must show what was owed then, not now.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Customer/Customers/Infrastructure/Doctrine/CustomerAccount/OpenBalanceAsOfSql.php:184-194; api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Infrastructure/Doctrine/AccountReceivable/Service/DbalAccountReceivableCustomerFetcher.php:88. V1 code, quoted: `cps.payment_date <= :asOfDate`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-019) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v12 (Confluence 947650561) does not change it. Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.
